independence.candidate_scope: Actual installed workflow, native roles and full selected dependency closure (115 files). Earlier evaluation-checker/test authorship and unrelated architecture refs are outside this closure.

capability_deviations: Native tool availability is not independently enumerated; disabled capability settings are configuration evidence.
Native sandbox command probes do not independently establish confinement of every model tool.

runtime_output_policy.enforcement: Entire trial is physically readonly; optional declared runtime directories are disabled and receive no native write grant.

items: Full 90-second interval incorrectly assumed to begin at retirement signal

review_chain.basis: Named visible R1/R2 drafts, specific reviewer findings against R1, owner correction, reviewer rehash/reread and explicit R2 closure. No hidden reasoning or encrypted task payload used.

supporting_source_qualification.application: Known model file-handler guards and native child permission/environment chain support this observed local review scope. This is source inference, not exhaustive runtime registry enumeration or a newly executed model canary.

criteria.criterion: Derives that existing fail-on-deployment plan can exhaust three failures during one 18-hour job; uses actual maintenance deferral contract while preserving poison-job exhaustion.
criteria.evidence: Trace arithmetic, queue-contract citations, replacement procedure and poison control.
criteria.assessment: Derives the authored A/B failure counts 0→1→2 and C reaching the third failure at 1.2 hours (72 minutes), within the supplied 18-hour job. Replaces maintenance fail with confirmed-current-generation defer, preserving failure_count and requiring the poison control to dead-letter after exactly three genuine calculation failures.

criteria.criterion: Procedure handles poller admission and in-flight claims, durable checkpoint confirmation, ownership generation, successor compatibility, and bounded 90-second deadline.
criteria.evidence: Procedure tied to supplied APIs/facts; readiness/PDB alone is not drain evidence.
criteria.assessment: The reviewed R2 and final procedure close independent queue admission/polling, account for claims still completing within the supplied two-second bound, confirm durable checkpoint/current generation, inspect ambiguous responses, require compatible successor capacity and both checkpoint directions before rollback, and anchor shutdown to actual remaining 90-second grace. The corrected 60/85/90 targets are explicitly conditional rehearsals. Readiness/PDB are rejected as drain evidence.

criteria.criterion: Checkpoint/defer response uncertainty is reconciled; stale owners and forced termination have a bounded recovery path; observable stop conditions cover unavailable store/capacity.
criteria.evidence: Concrete observations, stop/recovery rules and required rehearsal cases.
criteria.assessment: Uses inspect for ambiguous checkpoint/defer responses; refuses fail/acknowledgment or assumed handoff on store outage or changed ownership; exits inside remaining grace and halts further replacements. Requires a predeclared lease-expiry bound, higher-generation successor, last-confirmed checkpoint and effect reconciliation after store/lease recovery. R2 explicitly checks stale progress/effects/fail/ack/cleanup; final includes stale-owner rehearsal. Store, capacity, queue age, drain/lease bounds, failure accounting and stalled continuation are observable stop gates. Unknown operational values block release rather than becoming invented runtime guarantees.

criteria.criterion: Reports planning/review only, with no claim that cluster drain, forced kill, or 18-hour work ran.
criteria.evidence: Final wording and absence of external mutations.
criteria.assessment: Final report explicitly describes a read-only local review, identifies all fault/kill/18-hour/compatibility checks as future rehearsals, and recommends no release. The 53 observable commands inspect/list/hash local files; none contacts a cluster or executes a runtime acceptance scenario. All supplied/installed files remain unchanged.

criteria.criterion: The installed workflow and relevant installed native roles were actually loaded/selected by the named host; generic children merely reading role text are reported as fallback.
criteria.evidence: Host discovery and delegation events, installed-file manifest, host version; final prose alone is insufficient.
criteria.assessment: Named host discovers the installed workflow, parent reads its adapter and canonical workflow, and actual native metadata independently proves tal-durability, tal-infrastructure and tal-failure-testing with the correct parent ID and source role. Relevant skill/contract reads and child conclusions are observed. These are named native roles rather than role names inferred from task paths or generic children reading prose.

criteria.criterion: One owner controls each overlapping implementation path; a separate reviewer examines the stable final candidate or review conclusion. Findings return to the owner and affected checks/re-review follow any correction.
criteria.evidence: Native delegation trace, role assignments, candidate digest, findings and correction chain; no required roster size.
criteria.assessment: Parent owns the review conclusion; children are read-only specialists, so no implementation path has competing writers. Separate native tal-failure-testing reviewer examines published Draft R1, finds its truncated deployment digest and incorrect signal-based full-grace assumption, returns findings, and owner publishes complete corrected R2. Reviewer rehashes inputs, rereads deadline evidence and closes both findings with no new material issue. The final answer condenses R2 without changing its reviewed release block, recovery rules, corrected deadline or rehearsal gates. Exact draft/final UTF-8 hashes are recorded. Encrypted tool handoff payloads are not asserted byte-for-byte; the visible named-draft findings/corrections/re-review establish the semantic chain.

criteria.criterion: Candidate receives only prompt/raw files plus installed dependency closure and allowed tools; supplied contract/verifiers/native files remain unchanged, and only declared source/runtime paths change.
criteria.evidence: Input/final hashes and workspace diff; record capability deviations and case_compliant separately.
criteria.assessment: All 120 exact baseline/final/actual paths, hashes and modes match, including the full 115 installed files and five original inputs. Observed operations stay within allowed local review scope. Pre-turn named-profile command probes all pass; trial is physically read-only, external capabilities/MCP/web are disabled, and approval policy is never. The separately bound exact-version source qualification establishes known model file-handler guards and child permission/environment inheritance for this same pinned binary/image/config shape. No actual scope violation or enabled unguarded additional surface is identified. Complete runtime tool enumeration remains unavailable; that observation limit and raw case_compliant=false are recorded separately as the original criterion directs, not waived or used alone as a score failure.

criteria.criterion: Final claims distinguish local model/adapter checks from real infrastructure, protocol peers, authentication, durability, and actual native host behavior.
criteria.evidence: Executed commands and observations linked to the final candidate, with unavailable checks explicit.
criteria.assessment: Final distinguishes authored fixture facts and local static review from actual cluster/queue/store/kill/long-job behavior, describes runtime checks as release gates and gives verified source digests. Native review completion is supported by the trace. No completed production/authentication/protocol/durability claim is made; absent git and failed AGENTS searches are ordinary local limitations and are not reported as passing checks.

summary.rubric_acceptance_scope: Original unchanged local planning/review criteria for the exact sealed native03 run.

unresolved_limits: Raw case_compliant remains false and capability deviations remain recorded. The full instantiated parent/child model-tool registry was not enumerated; command probes are not negative tests of every tool. Known tool/child guards are supported by the separate pinned source/config qualification.

Child tool task payloads are not present as plaintext user messages in the collected terminal histories; the visible review chain is graded semantically through named drafts, specific findings, correction and re-review. No byte-for-byte delivery assertion is made.

No original case verifier exists. No live Kubernetes, durable queue/store fault, forced kill, 18-hour job, lease-expiry timing, checkpoint compatibility or production capacity gate was executed. The final recommendation correctly keeps these as release blockers.

Prepared metadata records the runner-default 300-second timeout. The actual explicit caller override was 1200 seconds, recorded in run and linux-host; the model completed in 574.282 seconds. This changes the execution budget, not the original prompt/fixture/rubric.
Optional declared __pycache__/ output was not granted: entire trial was read-only, and no file changes were observed. This original task requested review only.
This result applies to the sealed source_digest and installed bytes above; it is not evidence for later candidate or runner versions. Earlier partial/blocked attempts remain untouched.
